title: Scripture clearly teaches sin is taken away in the justified
source_text: I. Peccatum tolli in iis quos Deus in gratiam recipit; res est quae constat inter Christianos, & quam Scriptura ita clare atque aperte docet, ut a nemine, qui ejus authoritatem reveretur, in dubium vocari possit.
pass_a_gloss: That sin is taken away in those whom God receives into grace is a matter agreed among Christians, and which Scripture teaches so clearly and openly that no one who reveres its authority can call it into doubt.
pass_b_english: Among Christians it is settled that God takes away sin in those he receives into grace.
Scripture teaches this so plainly that no one who respects its authority can doubt it.
